title: Open Reply disrupts ManyChat with free Instagram DM #OpenReply #ManyChat #SocialMediaTools
description: A 17-year-old created Open Reply, an open source tool that automates Instagram comment replies by sending instant DMs when users type specific keywords. Open Reply offers the core functionality ManyChat charges up to $69 monthly for, enabling free automation with only minimal hosting costs. This innovation disrupts the social media marketing automation market by removing expensive subscription fees tied to user engagement volumes. Businesses can now scale Instagram outreach effortlessly across multiple accounts and teams while tracking link clicks precisely. Open Reply’s accessible setup paired with integration prompts simplifies deployment, giving marketers a cost-effective alternative to proprietary automation platforms.
